sources.title: issai/Qolda · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qolda Introduction Built on top of InternVL3.5 and Qwen3, Qolda is a small vision-language model designed to operate in Kazakh, Russian, and English. The model has 4.3B parameters and comprises the InternViT-300M vision encoder and MLP Projector components from InternVL3.5-4B, along with the Qwen3-4B language model. sources.title: GitHub - IS2AI/Qolda-deployment
sources.snippet: Qolda is ISSAI's latest open-source vision-language model fine-tuned for multimodal understanding. The model is available on HuggingFace at issai/Qolda. This Docker setup deploys Qolda using lmdeploy for serving the model via API.
